purpose: Define the sampling strata and deterministic selection rules before collecting the next State of the Agentic Web release so the corpus cannot be reshaped after observing protocol or Resolver outcomes.

assignmentPolicy.note: Priority resolves overlap only after a reviewer records all eligible strata. It is not inferred from Resolver output or protocol observations collected for the study.

targetDesign.note: Targets define the next release design, not a claim of statistical representativeness. A stratum shortfall is published rather than backfilled after outcome review.

requiredCandidateEvidence: eligibility rationale recorded before outcome collection

strata.title: Documentation and developer documentation
strata.definition: Public sites whose primary reviewed purpose is durable product, software, framework or technical documentation, excluding sites assigned to the higher-priority agent-native or developer-api strata.
strata.samplingFrame: Freeze a dated list of independently owned public documentation roots discovered from public project/product documentation references before protocol outcome collection.
strata.selectionRule: From eligible independent canonical hosts assigned to this stratum, sort by SHA-256(releaseSeed + NUL + canonicalHost) and take the first targetSitesPerStratum records without replacing selected failures.
knownBias: Public technical documentation over-represents digitally mature publishers.
English-language and developer-facing sources may be easier to discover than small regional documentation sites.
The stratum measures public agent-facing evidence, not private documentation or authenticated portals.

strata.title: Developer and API portals
strata.definition: Public developer portals whose reviewed primary purpose is API or integration consumption, with developer navigation or public API descriptions as a first-class surface.
strata.samplingFrame: Freeze a dated list of independently owned public developer/API portal roots from primary product documentation and public API/developer references before outcome collection.
strata.selectionRule: From eligible independent canonical hosts assigned to this stratum, sort by SHA-256(releaseSeed + NUL + canonicalHost) and take the first targetSitesPerStratum records without replacing selected failures.
knownBias: Public API portals bias toward vendors that intentionally expose developer ecosystems.
Private partner APIs and authenticated enterprise portals are outside observable scope.
An API portal may also contain ordinary documentation; overlap is resolved by the fixed assignment priority.

strata.title: Public knowledge bases and editorial reference sites
strata.definition: Public independently owned sites whose reviewed primary purpose is durable explanatory, reference or editorial knowledge rather than product documentation, API delivery or dataset publication.
strata.samplingFrame: Freeze a dated candidate frame of public knowledge/reference/editorial roots from public indexes and first-party canonical pages before protocol outcome collection.
strata.selectionRule: From eligible independent canonical hosts assigned to this stratum, sort by SHA-256(releaseSeed + NUL + canonicalHost) and take the first targetSitesPerStratum records without replacing selected failures.
knownBias: Editorial/reference boundaries are heterogeneous and require recorded eligibility rationale.
Large searchable publishers may be easier to discover than niche independent knowledge bases.
Content quality is not inferred from agent-interface availability.

strata.title: Datasets and research publications
strata.definition: Public sites whose reviewed primary purpose includes publishing research artifacts, datasets, methodology, citation metadata or durable downloadable/retrievable research outputs.
strata.samplingFrame: Freeze a dated list of independent public research/dataset publication roots from primary dataset/research landing pages and public scholarly/data references before outcome collection.
strata.selectionRule: From eligible independent canonical hosts assigned to this stratum, sort by SHA-256(releaseSeed + NUL + canonicalHost) and take the first targetSitesPerStratum records without replacing selected failures.
knownBias: Institutional repositories and commercial data portals differ materially in metadata practice.
DOI-indexed or repository-hosted research may be easier to discover than independent research sites.
Availability of a download does not establish machine-actionable licensing or provenance quality.

strata.title: Agent-native and AI-native products with declared agent interfaces
strata.definition: Public product sites with a first-party declaration of an agent-facing interface or agent interoperability surface such as MCP, A2A, Agent Skills, WebMCP, ARD or another explicitly documented agent interface.
strata.samplingFrame: Freeze a dated candidate frame from first-party public declarations of agent interfaces and independently owned product roots before runtime or Resolver outcome collection.
strata.selectionRule: From eligible independent canonical hosts assigned to this stratum, sort by SHA-256(releaseSeed + NUL + canonicalHost) and take the first targetSitesPerStratum records without replacing selected failures.
knownBias: This intentionally selects publishers already declaring agent interfaces and therefore must never be used as a general-web adoption estimate.
Fast-moving agent products can change between candidate-frame freeze and evidence capture; both dates must be retained.
A declared interface is not treated as functional until the study records the corresponding bounded evidence or not-assessed state.
